test_policy.notes: International first-year applicants need a high school GPA of 2.7, OR an ACT composite of 20, OR an SAT of 1030; so scores are only one of three ways to qualify.

requirements.notes: US$30 non-refundable fee. Documents: transcripts evaluated by a NACES-member credential service, Undergraduate Affidavit of Financial Support, and an original bank statement (signed and stamped by a bank official, dated within 6 months of the start term) showing a liquid US$ balance that covers the first year. Essays, recommendations and interviews are not mentioned on the pages read.

deadlines.label: Honors, President's Leadership Class, John Massey Leadership Scholars and Parsons Scholars applications (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Jan. 31, no year printed, so 2027 is assumed. Only for new incoming freshmen; the page does not say whether international students are eligible.

deadlines.label: General Scholarship application: priority date (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Mar. 1, no year printed, so 2027 is assumed. The final General Scholarship deadline is Aug. 1. You must be admitted first; the page does not say whether international students are eligible.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027 (applicants outside the U.S.)
deadlines.notes: Fall deadline is June 1 for students outside the U.S. and July 1 for students already in the U.S.; no year is printed, so fall 2027 is assumed. Spring deadlines are Nov. 1 (outside U.S.) and Dec. 1 (in the U.S.). No summer admission for international students.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Test scores are not needed if English is your first language or you graduated from a U.S. high school with four years of English. Students with a TOEFL iBT of 48-60 (old 0-120 scale) or an IELTS of 5.0 may meet the requirement instead by completing at least 12 weeks in an ESL program approved by the Oklahoma State Regents.

english.notes: The page lists 'TOEFL Internet-Based (iBT) 3.5' and says the iBT changed in 2026 to a new adaptive format with a 1-6 scale, so 3.5 is on the new scale. Paper-based 500 and computer-based 173 are also accepted. The old-scale iBT minimum is not printed (the ESL footnote covers 48-60).
PTE Academic. iTEP Academic 3.5 is also accepted. Duolingo and Cambridge are not listed on the page.

aid.notes: The international admissions pages list no scholarships specific to international students. Freshman scholarship programs (Honors, President's Leadership Class, John Massey Leadership Scholars, Parsons Scholars, General Scholarship) require admission first; amounts and international eligibility are not published on the page read. Federal aid is not available to international students in general.

cost.notes: Expected costs 2026-27 (tuition page): undergraduate tuition $243 per credit hour in-state and $569 out-of-state, with per-credit fees (student services $9, health and wellness $4, student infrastructure $13); the page says an out-of-state waiver offsets nonresident tuition so you pay the in-state rate, but it does not say whether international students qualify. 2025-26 catalog lists an international student status maintenance fee of $75. Housing runs $1,660-$3,790 per semester and meal plans $1,580-$2,300 per semester. The college-level figures above are 2024-25 College Navigator numbers

sat.note: Southeastern's international pages do not print an SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: No ACT code is printed on the pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read; look it up in the ETS code search.
